newsOverlay.marketBias: Post-FOMC conditions remain restrictive, but the initial dollar/oil tightening impulse has partially reversed: Reuters reports the dollar eased from its seven-week peak and oil extended declines. Institutional BTC/ETH ETF outflows remain a material bearish flow input. Crypto Reca independently has no real order; AVAX is best condition but remains NO TRADE/BLOCKED. Intelligence remains contextual and creates neither a buy nor sell signal.

items.headline: Dollar eases from seven-week peak as oil extends decline after Fed hike
items.summary: Reuters reports the dollar retreated from its post-Fed seven-week high while oil extended declines as Saudi supply reassurance reduced disruption fears. The reversal softens, but does not remove, the restrictive post-FOMC liquidity backdrop.
items.whyItMatters: A softer dollar and lower oil can relieve part of the immediate tightening impulse for crypto, while Fed policy and front-end yields remain restrictive.
items.actionReason: This is a material reversal of the earlier dollar/oil transmission signal, but it is not a buy signal and does not override Crypto Reca hard gates.

items.headline: Bitcoin and Ether spot ETF outflows extend to a second session after Fed hike
items.summary: Public reporting citing finalized Farside data says U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs lost about $295.9M and spot Ether ETFs $224.1M on September 16, about $520M combined. Together with September 15, combined BTC and ETH ETF redemptions were about $1.11B over two sessions.
items.whyItMatters: A second consecutive large redemption session indicates material near-term institutional flow pressure in BTC and ETH after the regulatory setback and Fed tightening.
items.actionReason: Material confirmed flow pressure warrants monitoring but does not independently justify REDUCE REVIEW or EXIT REVIEW and is not a sell instruction.

items.headline: Hawkish Fed lifts dollar to seven-week high as markets reprice tightening path
items.summary: Reuters reports the dollar index reached its strongest level since July 31 as short-term U.S. yields rose after the Fed hike and guidance for more tightening. Bitcoin was flat around $76,562 in early Asian trading.
items.whyItMatters: A stronger dollar and higher front-end yields are direct transmission channels from tighter Fed policy into less favorable liquidity conditions for crypto risk assets.
items.actionReason: The initial dollar spike has partially reversed; restrictive Fed policy remains relevant.

items.headline: Warsh says inflation remains too high and underlying trends have not meaningfully improved
items.summary: Reuters reports Fed Chair Kevin Warsh said inflation remains too high and persistent and that summer data have not shown meaningful improvement in underlying inflation trends.
items.whyItMatters: Hawkish guidance supports the risk of further tightening, higher real yields and a stronger dollar.
items.actionReason: Confirmed hawkish guidance keeps macro volatility risk elevated.

items.headline: Federal Reserve raises target rate 25 bp to 3.75%-4.00%
items.summary: Reuters confirms the Federal Reserve raised its key interest rate by 25 basis points to 3.75%-4.00%, the first increase in more than three years. The decision was unanimous and the Fed indicated more tightening is likely.
items.whyItMatters: A renewed Fed tightening cycle can lift real yields and reduce risk-asset liquidity.
items.actionReason: Further tightening remains possible; this is not an independent sell instruction.

items.headline: U.S. Senate fails to advance CLARITY Act
items.summary: The Senate procedural vote failed 49-50, short of the 60 votes required to advance the digital-asset market-structure bill.
items.whyItMatters: Failure to advance the bill sustains U.S. regulatory uncertainty.
items.actionReason: Resolved negative event; not an independent sell trigger.

items.headline: U.S. 10-year Treasury yield crosses 5%, highest since 2023
items.summary: Reuters reported the U.S. 10-year Treasury yield above 5% amid renewed inflation concerns, oil-price pressure and restrictive Fed expectations.
items.whyItMatters: A 5% 10-year yield raises the opportunity cost of holding risk assets.
items.actionReason: Material tightening in financial conditions, not an independent sell instruction.

catalysts.headline: Bank of Japan policy decision expected to raise rate to 1.25%
catalysts.summary: Reuters reports the Bank of Japan is expected to raise rates to 1.25%, a 31-year high, as inflation risks persist. Exact publication time remains unverified, so shorter-window escalation is not inferred.
catalysts.whyItMatters: Further Japanese tightening can affect global yields, yen carry trades and risk-asset liquidity.
catalysts.actionReason: HIGH catalyst is within 24 hours by calendar date, but exact decision time is unverified.
